recommendedFirstPatch.scope: sim.ts constructor/world initialization only, after root coordinates shared Game ownership; leave persistence/save/engine behavior and fallback semantics unchanged initially.
recommendedFirstPatch.design: Lazy per-instance OWN enumerable world property. At construction install getter/setter with Object.defineProperty. On first getter call, generate default0xdae1 once then replace own property with normal writable value. On reset assignment, setter directly installs provided requested WorldData as normal writable own property without ever generating default world. Preserve blank/walk/workBoard/runtime/RNG initialization. No shared cached WorldData.
recommendedFirstPatch.whyOwnProperty: Preserve existing Object.assign draft/command preflight semantics and public own world shape. Avoid JS#private lazy storage: prototype-only draft copies lack private slots. An ordinary TypeScript-private backing property is possible but changes enumerable shape; if chosen, explicitly qualify all Object.assign/Game snapshot consumers.
recommendedFirstPatch.factoryAlternative: Explicit internal deferred-world construction plus Game.createForReset(seed,version,options) can avoid public lazy property, but must prevent half-initialized Game escape and requires migrating callers. Keep normal newGame contract working; do not introduce undefined-world casts or shared default mutable world.
notThisPatch: Do not skip reset inside decodeGame: it initializes runtime caches/fields and consumes global RNG; a direct world assignment can change game semantics.

Do not weaken loadRaw to structural validation then reconstruct only winner without preserving fallback selection: previously a terrain-incompatible but structurally valid primary is rejected before seed/newest candidate selection.
Do not claim a simulation-worker migration or periodic-frame improvement based on constructor source alone.
